intro: Sara Balloo's Plea is a handwritten missive penned by a grieving widow in Ironforge. Unable to face the monarch directly in her sorrow, she entrusts this letter to a trusted champion of the Alliance to carry before King Magni Bronzebeard.

p: Written in the shadow of deep personal tragedy, Sara Balloo's Plea represents a humble appeal directly to Ironforge's throne. Rather than braving the High Seat herself in her grief-stricken condition, Sara seeks an adventurer who has demonstrated loyalty and valor to the Alliance to deliver her words. The message asks for the attention of King Magni Bronzebeard, drawing the sovereign's gaze toward the private mourning and sacrifices made by ordinary dwarven families serving the kingdom.
